cohorts.label: Pricing / Cost
cohorts.summary: Customers leave due to high cost, lack of value, or budget constraints.

cohorts.label: Feature / Integration gaps
cohorts.summary: Customers leave because required features or integrations are missing or inadequate.

cohorts.label: Support / Service
cohorts.summary: Customers leave due to slow, unhelpful, or generic support responses.

cohorts.label: Usability / Onboarding
cohorts.summary: Customers leave because the product is hard to set up, use, or has many bugs.

cohorts.label: Vendor Consolidation / Competition
cohorts.summary: Customers leave because their organization standardizes on another tool or consolidates vendors.

cohorts.label: Temporary / No longer needed
cohorts.summary: Customers leave because they are taking a break, forgot subscription, or project ended.
